newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index marginally up, market quiet.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index marginally up, market quiet.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius index Semdex rose a marginal 0.33 points on Monday to close at 388.94, bourse officials said.
Turnover amounted to 10.10 million rupees on 730,749 shares from 26.85 million rupees on 1,685,979 shares on last Friday.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 90 rupees on 13,720 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged to 12 on 377,228 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel climbed 30 cents to 48.50 on 1,600 shares, New Mauritius Hotels rose 40 cents to 37.60 on 4,250 shares and Sun Resorts fell a rupee to 50.50 rupees on 15,000 shares.
In the commerce sector, Rogers gained one rupee to 100 but it was not traded and Ireland Blyth Ltd gained 40 cents to 16.60 rupees on 5,677 shares.
Industry-based Mauritius Breweries Ltd was 5.0 rupees higher at 155s on 3,516 shares and Mauritius Oil Refineries was unchanged at 11.50 rupees on 10,000 shares.
In the investment sector, Mauritius Development and Investment Trust lost 20 cents to 7.40 on 265,000 shares and Fincorp rose a rupee to 73.00 rupees on 1,000 shares.
Air Mauritius climbed 10 cents to 38.90 on 580 shares.
